ali-expandings-wise-men-flash-root.description: Use when the user asks for a "flash council", "quick council", "fast panel", "wise men flash", "quick second opinion from a panel", or invokes /wise-men-flash — and when they want a council-quality answer to a hard question fast (four subagent calls and about a third of the full council's time, a median 16.7 minutes in its own pre-registered round) rather than the full wise-men protocol. A three-member council of a practitioner anchor named for the job the question belongs to, one domain member, and a Devil's Advocate — each reasoning down a different path, spawned in parallel. No peer-review…
